text:
Type: kilim-style flatwoven area rug
Use: anchoring a living area or bed; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, Scandinavian, rustic
Materials: handwoven flat weave, wool-look yarn, white tasselled fringe at both ends
Colors: cool grey, dusty purple, off-white, black
Shape: rectangle with horizontal bands of small diamond and arrow motifs, fringed short ends, flat and thin, medium-large
Feel: earthy, cosy, crafted, relaxed
Goes with: light or warm wood, white walls, grey or lilac textiles, plants; bohemian, Scandinavian or rustic rooms

product.name: KATTRUP
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
